note_ko: 헤어 프리셋. 고르면 LoRA 헤어가 통째로 빠지고 이걸로 교체된다. main_en(새 상태), closing_en(남는 가능성을 닫는 문장)은 보통/상세 모두, echo_en(다른 표현 반복)은 상세에서만 쓴다. {color}=LoRA의 hair_color, {p}/{P}=her/Her.

뱅 + 긴 생머리.desc_ko: 이마를 덮는 앞머리와 어깨 아래로 곧게 내려오는 긴 머리
뱅 + 긴 생머리.main_en: {P} {color} hair falls straight and loose past {p} shoulders, with a full set of soft, straight bangs lying across {p} forehead
뱅 + 긴 생머리.closing_en: nothing is tied up or gathered into a knot, and the bangs cover most of {p} forehead down to just above {p} eyebrows
뱅 + 긴 생머리.echo_en: The bangs sweep evenly over {p} forehead, and the long {color} hair hangs freely down {p} back and over {p} shoulders
뱅 + 긴 생머리.echo2_en: Straight, soft bangs frame {p} brow while the long {color} hair spills smoothly down {p} back

높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).desc_ko: 머리 전부를 정수리 위 큰 매듭 하나로 묶은 스타일
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).main_en: ALL of {p} {color} hair is pulled straight up and back off {p} face and wound into one very large, tall, unmistakable knot on the very top of {p} head, clearly visible rising above the outline of {p} head
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).closing_en: {p} ears, neck and shoulders are completely bare of long hair and nothing falls loose past {p} shoulders, only a few short wisps cling to {p} neck and temples
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).echo_en: Seen from any angle, the single tall knot crowns {p} head while {p} neck and shoulders stay clear
높은 올림머리 (한 덩어리 매듭).echo2_en: The whole mass of {color} hair rises into that one tall knot, leaving {p} nape and neck uncovered

낮은 포니테일.desc_ko: 목덜미 높이에서 하나로 묶은 낮은 포니테일
낮은 포니테일.main_en: {P} {color} hair is gathered at the nape of {p} neck into one smooth low ponytail that hangs straight down {p} back
낮은 포니테일.closing_en: {p} forehead and face are fully open and no hair falls loose past {p} shoulders
낮은 포니테일.echo_en: The low ponytail rests between {p} shoulder blades, tied neatly at the nape
낮은 포니테일.echo2_en: A single smooth ponytail falls from the nape of {p} neck, and {p} face stays open
